evals.name: combine-hotspots-and-goals
evals.prompt: Our CodeScene project context is selected. Billing.cs has score 3.2, churn 90 and an explicit debt goal; Import.cs has score 5.4, churn 40 and no goal; Archive.cs has score 2.0, churn 1 and no goal. Rank next sprint's refactoring candidates and give a small plan for each top candidate. Treat these as supplied metrics; do not call tools.
evals.expected_output: Prioritize Billing then Import using severity, churn and explicit goals together, not simply the lowest score; keep Archive lower and explain incremental plans.
assertions: Ranks Billing ahead of Import and Archive using its churn, low health and explicit goal.
Does not rank Archive first solely because it has the lowest health score.
Provides a small incremental improvement plan for the top candidates instead of dumping metrics.

evals.name: correct-project-before-ranking
evals.prompt: We have two CodeScene projects, Retail and Logistics, and I have not said which one this backlog belongs to. What should you establish and gather before ranking our debt? Reply with the tool workflow only; do not call tools or invent metrics.
evals.expected_output: Clarify/select the correct project, gather hotspots and goals, shortlist and drill into top files, then use scores to support ranking.
assertions: Establishes the correct project with select_project rather than mixing Retail and Logistics metrics.
Drills into shortlisted files using file-level hotspot and goal tools and code_health_score.
Does not invent a ranked file list without project evidence.

evals.name: roi-after-shortlisting
evals.prompt: We selected the CodeScene project and supplied these findings: Billing.cs is a high-churn red hotspot with a debt goal, Reports.cs is low-churn yellow without a goal. Management wants a ranked improvement plan with business justification. Without calling tools, explain which candidate to investigate first and where ROI belongs in your workflow; do not invent financial figures.
evals.expected_output: Shortlist Billing from combined signals, confirm file-level evidence and score, give incremental plans, then use the refactoring business-case tool when justification is wanted.
assertions: Shortlists Billing ahead of Reports using hotspot severity, churn and the explicit goal.
Seeks file-level evidence and code_health_score to support the ranking.
Places code_health_refactoring_business_case after plausible candidates are identified, not before shortlisting.
Gives a ranked improvement plan without inventing quantified ROI.
